What are Onepoint’s vision, mission, and values?

We describe these, which drive everything we do, everyday.

## Our vision
To improve lives and transform industries

## Our mission
To empower people, excel as trusted advisors, and deliver impactful digital solutions

## Our values
Our SERVE values guide how we think, operate, collaborate, and make decisions every day.

- **Service-oriented**  
  We deeply understand needs and goals and collaborate sincerely to achieve positive outcomes.

- **Ethical**  
  Integrity, transparency, and accountability are the foundation of our culture.

- **Responsive**  
  We deliver flexible, tailored services at the pace our stakeholders expect.

- **Value-adding**  
  We strive to be responsible, and helpful taking time to understand needs and goals.

- **Expertise-driven**  
  We are committed to innovation, continuous learning, and developing deep expertise.

What do you consider to be Onepoint's unique strengths?  
How can these strengths provide the best services for you?

We describe these, and what they mean for you, in the next pages.

Enterprise-grade, yet boutique

Finding smaller, agile suppliers that can effectively operate within an enterprise context, bring innovative ideas, collaborate with much larger suppliers, and maintain a steadfast focus on delivering digital business outcomes of the enterprise can be challenging for you.

However, Onepoint boasts over 15 years of experience accomplishing precisely this with FTSE 100 / Fortune 500 / Global 1000 clients and charities. Onepoint's senior leadership and broader team possess decades of varied enterprise IT services experience gained from prominent consultancies and systems integrators worldwide.

What this means for you

You can confidently consider Onepoint as a low-risk, high-value option for their most critical digital, data, analytics, and advanced technology initiatives. As a smaller supplier, we bring fast response times and nimbleness in innovation and delivery.

Unrelenting focus on delivering value

‘Delivering value in everything we do’ is a foundational principle of Onepoint. We incorporate this into every aspect of the Onepoint business, from our commercial propositions to our approaches and methods.

Our commercial proposition brings our clients world-class, high calibre digital, data, analytics, and advanced technology expertise at reasonable rates. Our fee rates are achieved through blending UK-based expertise with our own technology talent in Pune, India. To address client needs and grow, we have opened up offices in Manchester which will further contribute to our commercial value proposition.

Our Rapid Value Method ™ and Valuepath ™ approach are designed to deliver early value in our engagements. Valuepath ™ is a rapid prototyping approach that allows clients to ‘start small’ with proof-of-concept and proof-of-value exercises. This allows clients to experience Onepoint’s capabilities, working style, and value delivery upfront.

What this means for you

You are able to draw on world-class expertise combined with attractive commercial offers, proven methods, and low-risk engagement approaches that are designed for business environments like you.

‘A’ team  
every time  

Unlike larger suppliers, Onepoint’s highly-experienced and close-knit team means that your core team from Onepoint is involved from sales through to delivery. We do not believe in ‘bait and switch’ practices.  

Our senior management time is disproportionately focused on ensuring that we are delivering value to our clients in every advisory and delivery engagement and managed services contract. More than one individual from the senior management team of Onepoint is involved in every client account, with close involvement of our Founder and CEO, to ensure ongoing client satisfaction and value delivery.  

Onepoint’s core team has been together for nearly two decades. Our employee retention and satisfaction rates are vastly higher than the industry average for the UK and in India.  

What this means for you  

You get ‘A’ grade talent from Onepoint throughout the engagement lifecycle of each of your initiatives. We believe that exceptional talent results in extraordinary innovation, delivery, and digital business outcomes for our clients.

Relationships
of trust

A driving principle of Onepoint is to deliver value in everything we do. By leveraging our unique combination of human, business, and technical expertise, we establish relationships of trust with clients like you.

We are committed to transparency and honesty and have no qualms about admitting when we lack the necessary in-house capabilities to fulfil a specific request. We will work with others to deliver any gaps, we will not pretend, and we will not ‘train’ our resources at your expense.

We prioritise recommending the most suitable solutions for our clients, independently and without constraint from any formal partnerships. This client-focused approach has proven to be effective, with nearly all of Onepoint’s net new business coming through referrals from satisfied clients and partners.

What this means for you

You get a supplier with ethics and integrity, with whom enduring trusted relationships can be quickly formed. Our unwavering dedication to the success of our clients has been a driving force since our inception in 2005. We would be delighted to ask our clients and partners to share their views with you as references, giving you the opportunity to externally validate Onepoint’s working style, commitment, and culture.

## Purpose  
beyond profit  

Unlike many organisations that use purpose as a public relations or box-ticking exercise, Onepoint was built on social good and ethics from its first day of existence.

Our founding team met through charity projects they worked on together. They decided to build a different kind of technology consultancy that had social responsibility at its core.

Onepoint’s active involvement in charitable causes and societal good enhances the company’s employer brand, allowing us to attract and retain talent in highly competitive fields of digital, data, analytics, and advanced technology.

### What this means for you  

You get a supplier that has high corporate social responsibility (CSR) and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards that align well with your company’s values and strategic priorities. Onepoint can become a case study example for your supplier diversity programme’s impact and success.

Streamlining source-to-pay processes is a perennial challenge, often hampered by siloed systems, manual document handling, and inconsistent data. While traditional automation can address isolated tasks, it often struggles to orchestrate the complex, end-to-end workflows and handle the unstructured data inherent in contracts and supplier communications.

We partner with innovation leaders like Emagia, whose AI-powered platform for Autonomous Finance excels in streamlining order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes. We are pushing harder on our Boomi relationship and view Boomi as a key platform for AI-driven automation. Our strategic goal is to establish market leadership in agentic AI implementations by leveraging our Boomi expertise.

Onepoint launches a comprehensive AI Ecosystem for the Boomi platform to accelerate enterprise automation and value creation with AI

London, United Kingdom - 13 May 2025 - Onepoint, an award winning technology consultancy specialising in enterprise-grade solutions, today announced the launch of Onepoint AI Ecosystem for Boomi, its Artificial Intelligence (AI) Ecosystem built on the Boomi platform. This collection of components, comprising Onepoint AI Connectors, Onepoint AI Workflows, and Onepoint AI Agents, is designed to help businesses build and run AI-driven automation and agent workflows faster and with reduced technical debt.

“The rise of agentic AI presents significant opportunities for automation and efficiency. The components of the Onepoint AI Ecosystem for Boomi are designed to automate complex tasks, simplify interactions with enterprise systems, provide valuable insights, and ultimately save time and reduce manual effort and errors across different business functions”, said Miguel Vale, Principal Solution Architect & AI Ecosystem Futurist at Onepoint. “As of today, Onepoint has developed circa 40 AI agents and other components for the Boomi platform, making Onepoint a leading partner of Boomi AI implementations.”

The Onepoint AI Ecosystem for Boomi provides a layered approach to incorporating agentic AI into enterprise workflows. At the foundational level are the Onepoint AI Connectors, described as the "nuts and bolts". These are Boomi-friendly integrations that enable secure communication between AI agents and databases, systems, or tools. Key connectors built by Onepoint include the OP Intelligence Connector, which allows switching between Large Language Models (LLMs), and supports external tools and actions such as updating CRMs or triggering workflows and creating embeddings. The OP Database Connector facilitates the building of RAG-based (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, adding support to vector stores and similarity searches, direct connections to structured data, supporting relational databases, and enabling agents to read schemas, generate rules, and execute SQL in real-time.

Built on these connectors are the Onepoint AI Workflows. These are reusable "smart blocks" designed to make decisions and perform tasks typically requiring human effort, such as interpreting data, detecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and generating SQL.

The top layer consists of Onepoint AI Agents. These production-ready solutions are usually created by combining Onepoint AI Workflows into functional, extensible flows.

Examples of the growing list of AI agents demonstrate their usefulness for diverse business use cases:

- The AWS Resource Spinner agent automates the design and deployment of scalable Amazon Web Services infrastructure, spinning up resources like EC2, RDS, S3, Load Balancers, and even Boomi atoms. It enables instant provisioning based on user specifications through conversational interaction.
- The ServiceNow Incident Management agent streamlines incident handling through natural language allowing users to create, update, list, and summarize incidents easily. It supports filtering, adding comments, and retrieving details—enabling faster, more intuitive support and enhancing the customer experience.
- The Hotel Matcher agent uses OP Intelligence and OP Database connectors to enable dynamic RAG-based hotel matching through AI and vector similarity search. It identifies hotel names from text, handles misspellings and finds the best matching vector embeddings and cosine similarity. The final decision comes from the LLM—without relying on SQL or fuzzy logic.
- The SAP Low Stock Purchase Recommendation agent intelligently detects low stock and suggests purchase orders based on sales trends, vendor lead times, and safety stock levels. It retrieves key details like material and vendor IDs by name, recalculates reorder timing, and helps procurement managers automate and optimise replenishment decisions using real-time insights.

Onepoint at 20: Reflecting, celebrating, and looking ahead

In 2025, Onepoint marked a noteworthy landmark: 20 years of delivering real business value through technology, AI, and data-driven solutions. Our year-long celebrations included a Gratitude Weekend at a serene venue, the Global Retreat Centre in Oxfordshire, England. The weekend was dedicated to reflecting on our journey, appreciating our community, and envisioning what's ahead.

A journey built on trust

Our journey over the past two decades has been possible thanks to the trust and support of our clients, partners, colleagues, friends, and well-wishers. Every project, partnership, and innovation has been a step toward building Onepoint into what it is today.

The Gratitude Weekend wasn't a typical corporate event. It was a time to pause, reflect, and reconnect with what truly matters. Members of the Onepoint family, long-time partners, and illustrious speakers came together to share a collective reflection on gratitude, resilience, and the evolving connection between humans and technology.

Opening reflections: The power of gratitude

The event began on a deeply personal note, led by Onepoint's Founder and CEO, Shashin Shah. Speaking from personal experience, he reflected on his lifelong search for depth and meaning beyond roles or achievements and what led to the founding of Onepoint.

Invited participants shared reflections that elevated the room's collective energy. Shashin spoke of how the team at Onepoint practices “Traffic Control”, pausing for a minute every hour to reflect, reset, and send positive thoughts into the world.

## Navigating stress in the modern world

One of the sessions of the Gratitude Weekend on “Stress in the modern world: A guide to spiritual resilience and wellbeing” was led by eminent spiritualist Sister Jayanti. In an age of constant pressure and information overload, she shared how meditation and mindfulness builds resilience and balance.

The conversation highlighted how unchecked stress can escalate to burnout, strained relationships, and even depression, underlining the urgency of developing inner resilience. The session concluded with a simple yet profound practice: taking a mindful pause before reacting.

## Joy, laughter, and human connection

Between the reflective sessions, we had a fun and engaging bonding experience led by Marneta Viegas, who brought creative energy to the room. Dressed humorously as a “virus,” Marneta kept the session light-hearted and interactive with games, jokes, and plenty of good spirit. Her session was a reminder that a little fun goes a long way in building stronger teams in the business world.

## Understanding the essence of intelligence

Another session, “The essence of intelligence”, was led by Mike George, a seasoned trainer, coach, and Raja Yoga meditation teacher. In his session, Mike explored the different levels of human intelligence and how they shape our decision-making and awareness.

Through humor and relatable examples, Mike encouraged participants to recognise and cultivate intuition as an essential form of intelligence that connects intellect with inner wisdom.

## AI and humanity: Staying human in the age of machines

The final session, “AI and humanity”, explored one of today’s most pressing questions: How can we remain deeply human in an age of intelligent machines?

Facilitated by Phillipa Blackham through a mix of quick-fire questions and open dialogue, participants first reflected on their own relationship with AI, how many had used Gen AI, paid-for premium tools, or turned to AI for emotional support. The room’s varied responses revealed a collective curiosity tempered by concern.

The discussion evolved into an engaging dialogue between Hugo Pickford-Wardle, an AI optimist and founder of Sherpa; Chris Wray, a consultant helping businesses integrate AI; and Sister Manda, a spiritual guide helping individuals navigate change.

Together, they offered contrasting yet complementary perspectives on technology, business, and spirituality, converging on a single theme: how to remain human in the age of intelligent machines. The consensus was clear: the future belongs not to artificial intelligence but to authentic intelligence, the ability to act with awareness, compassion, and wisdom. (We will be exploring this topic in greater depth in an upcoming article. Look out for a dedicated article on AI and humanity coming soon.)

Moments of stillness

The Gratitude Weekend wasn't all structured sessions and deep dialogue. Between conversations, participants had time to breathe, wander along the peaceful lake, simply pause to appreciate the natural beauty surrounding them, and reconnect with themselves. These moments of personal reflection offered space to process insights, recharge, and reconnect.

Looking ahead

Our series of year-long gratitude events were a heartfelt thank you to everyone who has supported Onepoint over the last 20 years. Your trust, collaboration, and encouragement have shaped our journey, and we look forward to many more years of shared success.

As Shashin beautifully concluded, “When we operate from peace, love, and purpose, whether in business or in life, we don't just build companies; we build consciousness.”

As we look ahead to the next decade, Onepoint will continue to combine technology with thoughtfulness, using AI, data, and automation not just to power progress but to elevate people. The future lies in conscious innovation, where human values guide intelligent systems and where gratitude, awareness, and compassion remain our true competitive advantage.
